levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: The leading «7-106» and the blessings are not part of the surfaces.
«محمد بن الحسن» appears twice in succession but names two men, each with its own «حدثنا» (the counter-example in rule 7): two links.
«عن أبيه سليمان الديلمي»: «أبيه» with a name is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7).
The Imam is named after «عن» inside the chain, so he is a narrator; his words that follow are the saying.
